LAX360 provides reusable backend services, APIs and SaaS infrastructure, so developers, startups, agencies and businesses can add proven building blocks to their products instead of building each one from scratch.

Most products need the same backend building blocks: sign-in, subscriptions, bookings, notifications, payments and file handling. strings.s: AI assistants are now good enough to be useful in ordinary businesses, but they are not magic. The teams that get value from them start with a narrow job and a clear measure of success.
strings.section: AI assistants for everyday business: where they help and where they do not
AI assistants for everyday business: where they help and where they do not

strings.s: Assistants work best on repetitive questions with known answers: opening hours, order status, product details, how to book. They answer instantly, at any hour, and free your team for conversations that need judgement.
They are also good at first drafts. Summaries of long documents, replies to routine emails and meeting notes can all start from an assistant and finish with a person.

An assistant should not decide anything with legal, financial or safety consequences on its own. It should also not answer from memory when the right answer lives in your own documents. Give it approved information to answer from, and make handover to a person easy.
Pick one question your team answers every day. Write down the approved answer, let the assistant handle it, and review the conversations weekly. Expand only when the first job works.

strings.s: Good software is rarely the result of one brilliant effort. It comes from small, repeated habits that keep a codebase healthy while the product keeps changing.
strings.section: Building software that lasts: five habits of teams that ship reliably
Building software that lasts: five habits of teams that ship reliably

strings.s: A clear problem statement saves more time than any tool. If the team cannot say in two sentences what a feature is for, it is not ready to build.
Small changes are easier to review, easier to test and easier to undo. Aim for work that can ship in days, not months.
You do not need to test everything. Test the paths that earn money or protect data, and automate those tests so they run on every change.
Code review spreads knowledge and catches mistakes early. It works best when it is fast and kind.
Document decisions, keep dependencies current and budget time for maintenance. Software that is not maintained quietly becomes software that cannot be changed.

strings.s: Many ideas start with the question "should we build an app?" The honest answer depends on who will use it and how often.
strings.section: Website, web app or mobile app: which should you build first?
Website, web app or mobile app: which should you build first?

strings.s: If people need to find you, understand what you offer and get in touch, start with a fast, clear website. It is the cheapest way to be visible.
If your team or customers need to log in, manage records or complete tasks, a web app works on every device without installation and is quicker to improve.
Choose a mobile app when you need device features such as notifications, offline use or the camera, or when people will use it daily.
Many businesses begin with a website, add a web app for the core workflow, and build a mobile app only when usage justifies it. Planning the pieces together from the start keeps them consistent.

strings.s: LAX360 Pvt Ltd builds software, AI and automation solutions, runs digital marketing, and delivers training. Our partnership ecosystem exists so that people and businesses who want to grow with us have a clear, honest way to do it.

You can open an approved LAX360 business as a franchisee, support our sales as an authorized partner, or simply refer people who need our services. Each model has its own commitment, responsibilities and earning rules, which we explain openly before you apply.
These programs are open to entrepreneurs, professionals and existing businesses. Every application is an enquiry: approval follows a consultation, verification and an agreement.
Choose how you want to take part. Each program has its own page for Education, Digital Marketing and IT & Software.

A franchise is a formal agreement to set up and run an approved LAX360 business in an agreed territory, with your own premises, team and investment, following LAX360 standards. Commercial terms are still being finalised and are discussed during evaluation.

Authorized Partners help LAX360 with business development, lead generation, customer communication and sales coordination. They are not franchise owners and do not run an independent delivery centre. Registration is free; commission depends on the approved product, service, deal and partner agreement.

Referral Partners introduce potential customers to LAX360. LAX360 handles qualification, follow-up, quotations and delivery. There is no registration fee and no centre to operate. Eligible commission is payable only when the approved referral conditions are met.

The Authorized Partner shall not collect project advances, milestone payments, service fees or any other customer payments on behalf of LAX360 unless prior written authorization is provided by the Company.

All project payments shall preferably be made directly to the officially designated bank account of LAX360.
The Authorized Partner shall not collect payments into personal bank accounts or unauthorized business accounts.

The partner shall not independently modify payment terms, offer unauthorized discounts, provide payment extensions or make financial commitments to customers without prior written approval from LAX360.

The Authorized Partner shall not make any commitments regarding refunds, adjustments or payment settlements without approval from the Company.
All commercial arrangements between LAX360 and the Authorized Partner shall be discussed individually and mutually agreed upon by both parties.
Revenue-sharing arrangements, partner commissions, recurring service benefits, payment schedules and other financial terms shall be documented separately in a written agreement.
Any applicable revenue share or commission shall be determined based on the agreed commercial terms and the eligible service amount actually received by LAX360.
GST, refunds, cancelled transactions, discounts and separately charged third-party expenses shall be excluded from commercial calculations unless otherwise mutually agreed in writing.

For projects involving milestone-based payments, any applicable partner share shall be considered proportionately based on the eligible payments received by LAX360, subject to the separately agreed terms.

For annual maintenance, recurring support or other periodic services, any applicable commercial benefit shall be provided only where the arrangement, duration and payment conditions have been approved in writing.
No commission or revenue share shall be payable on cancelled projects, refunded amounts or unpaid customer invoices.
Any changes to the agreed commercial arrangements shall be valid only when mutually approved and recorded in writing by both parties.
Commercial terms are not published on this website. Partners who require further information may contact the LAX360 management team for an individual discussion.
